analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (87,135 KRW) below SMA5 (89,755 KRW), below SMA20 (103,986 KRW), below SMA50 (105,415 KRW): diagnosing short-to-mid term bearish trend
· Below SMA100 (114,520 KRW), below SMA200 (99,623 KRW): indicating long-term bearish strength
· 52-week position (34.2%) + current price level historically low
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.6→27.4) continues in oversold territory: maintaining bearish momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1423.0682→-2402.2051) continues to worsen: suggesting further downside pressure
· Bollinger Band current price position (87,135 KRW) approaching lower band (85,545 KRW): downside pressure present
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 82,500 KRW: potential acceleration of decline if 5-day low (85,670 KRW) is breached
· Swing resistance at 89,550 KRW: possibility of a short-term bounce attempt if broken
· 5-day high (98,195 KRW) < 20-day high (114,930 KRW) → potential Lower High formation: continuing bearish trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): subdued volume lowers conviction for trend reversal
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): maintain wait-and-see due to lack of clear reversal signals
